controller.notes: Normal DemoPICO Play Mode application frames, desktop mono, no XR initialization or APK. 1200-second timestamp route. No MCP diagnostics during measurement. Domain reload temporarily disabled only to retain this controller; original Editor options restored on exit. Device FPS and stereo are unverified.

notes: Timestamp route in the actual application player loop; XR initialization disabled. CSV takes 10Hz snapshots, not every frame; reported maxima/P95 can miss spikes. FrameTimingManager values are application-frame samples, not per-pass GPU measurements. Unavailable values are -1 and excluded. OS page cache was not flushed. External process memory is sampled every10s. No PICO/Android/device90Hz or leak-free claim. Unity total allocation, plugin cache budgets, driver memory and process private bytes are different measures.
